reels.hook: Freeze dried and spray dried are not the same thing.
reels.hook_text: Freeze dried and spray dried are not the same thing.
reels.hook_spoken: Two jars can both say instant coffee and be made completely differently.

frames.spoken: Two jars can both say instant coffee and be made completely differently.
Spray drying uses hot air. It is fast, and heat costs aroma.
Freeze drying works cold, so more of the aroma survives the process.
Freeze dried looks like crystals. Spray dried looks like fine powder.
Purity Beans is freeze dried arabica. 100% coffee, zero chicory.

reels.hook: If your coffee tastes weak, the fix is usually the spoon.
reels.hook_text: If your coffee tastes weak, the fix is usually the spoon.
reels.hook_spoken: Weak coffee is almost always a dose problem, not a coffee problem.

frames.spoken: Weak coffee is almost always a dose problem, not a coffee problem.
Start with one level teaspoon for a small cup. Level, not heaped.
Use the same cup every morning so you are changing one thing at a time.
Too weak, add a quarter spoon tomorrow. Not a whole one.
Three mornings and you will have your number. Then it is the same every day.
